disclaimer: This app is for self-reflection, not medical, legal or financial advice.
welcomeBody: Explore your birth chart, your relationships, and the days ahead.
languageHint: Choose your language. You can change it anytime.
providerUnavailable: This sign-in method is not connected yet. Please use email for the preview.
codeHint: Enter the six-digit code sent to your email.
error: We couldn’t complete that. Check your connection and try again.
legalUnavailable: Legal text has not been supplied yet. This preview is not ready for public release.
consent.birthData.placeholder: DRAFT CONSENT — I agree to processing my birth data for this preview. Legal wording awaits review.
name: Your name
timeHint: The exact time matters: your rising sign and houses can change within minutes. Check your birth certificate or hospital records, or ask your family.
noPlaces: No places found. Check the spelling or try a nearby larger town.
locationHint: We couldn’t find a nearby city. Please search for your location.
optional: Optional. You can skip this step.
notificationHint: Choose whether to receive reminders about the days ahead. You can change this in Settings.
buildingTitle: Your chart is ready to explore.
readingPending: Your full reading can be prepared while you explore.
recalculate: Changing birth data recalculates this chart and every reading for it.
emptyReports: Readings you open are saved here.
deleteExplanation: Your sessions end now. Your profiles, readings and conversations will be deleted within 30 days.
phaseMessage: Your account and charts are ready. This area will arrive in the next build.
homeBody: Start with your chart. Keep the people who matter close.
profileLimit: You can save up to 50 people.
slow: This is taking longer than usual.
